text: A psalm of thanksgiving.Shout joyfully to the Lord, all you lands;
serve the Lord with gladness;come before him with joyful song.
t[1]Know that the Lord is God,he made us, we belong to him,we are his people, the flock he shepherds. [AA]
Enter his gates with thanksgiving,his courts with praise.Give thanks to him, bless his name; [AB]
good indeed is the Lord,His mercy endures forever,his faithfulness lasts through every generation.
